drafted: 2026-10-28 Cairo by Build (claude-code), from the Integration roadmap item (one finite breakout_pyramid falsification contract; positive entry edge before management/pyramiding credit), revised to Integration ruling Codex 6468454634
ruling: Codex 6468454634: isolate entry edge before management credit; entry-only/plain-stop vs the same entries with pyramiding; causal next-open fills; actual/base plus 1.5x costs; the fixed 17-symbol no-LSK book; three chronological slices; per-symbol concentration / remove-best-symbol; drawdown; a minimum episode/frequency gate. The existing triage result is development triage, not acceptance evidence. No sealed holdout, no PAPER settings
signing: This file is the authoritative contract; the docs twin is a summary. It lands DRAFT; Integration (codex) freezes the numbers and flips status/signed before merge, then creates research_evidence/ledger/breakout_pyramid_falsify.jsonl plus one REGISTRY.jsonl line, before any market result is computed
motivation: Integration local triage (development packet, legacy flat-funding / filter assumptions) flagged breakout_pyramid long on the fixed 17-symbol book as a high-drawdown probation candidate. No triage number is evidence here

source.coverage: all 17 symbols are STATIC-40 members (ranks 1-20); the EDGE05 metadata coverage check (funding_carry_xsec.v1 coverage_check) reports 40/40 symbols with no month gaps for 4h klines, fundingRate and 1h mark klines over 2020-02-03 to 2026-09-28; no new data is needed

identity.source_sha256_rule: sha256 of inspect.getsource(obj) with CRLF normalised to LF (function-level binding: unrelated edits elsewhere in strategies.py do not move it)

file_sha256_at_base_commit.note: informational; the runner binds its own code identity (git commit + dirty flag + sha256 of every module it imports) into run.json as the EDGE05 runner does

params.atr: Wilder ATR14 (true range ewm alpha 1/14, adjust False)
params.entry: le at the close of 4h bar t = close_t > max(high over bars t-20..t-1) AND EMA50_t > EMA200_t
params.signal_exit: none (lx is never true); every exit is the stage's stop / time cap / trail
params.reentry: one open episode per symbol; a symbol re-arms only after its episode closes

fills.signal: computed on the CLOSED 4h bar t only (the channel high is shifted one bar; no intrabar or future value)
fills.entry_fill: market (taker) at the open of bar t+1; never at the signal bar's close
fills.time_exit_fill: market at the open of the bar after the cap is reached
fills.stop_and_add_fills: intrabar at the level in backtest.py path order (FBL-BT01): gap/open first, then conservative stop-first; a bar that opens through a stop fills at the open; pyramid adds fire in path order before the stop
fills.stop_reference: the stop distance uses ATR of signal bar t, set from the t+1 fill price

universe.rule: engine.CAND_FIXED18 at base_commit minus LSKUSDT (Integration ruling Codex 6468454634)
universe.selection_bias: Integration chose this list, and the fixed-18 list was itself picked after factory results; the book is survivor- and selection-biased. A pass here is weaker evidence than a pass on a pre-existing list
universe.report_only: STATIC-40 (research_evidence/universe/static-top40-minhist365-contract-20261011.json) is reported beside the primary as a selection-bias check; it adds no trial and can neither pass nor rescue anything
universe.eligibility: a symbol is decided only once its contiguous closed 4h history inside the opened slice reaches 240 bars; a gap restarts the count; no forward fill; symbols listed later simply start later

S1.rule: plain 2.0 ATR stop, exit at the next open after 42 bars (7 days); no target, trail, breakeven, partial, add or ttp

S2.role: H2 trail stage (live management without adds)
S2.rule: live 2.0 ATR stop and 3 ATR chandelier trail, no adds, no time cap; S2 and S3 are identical except the pyramid block

S3.role: H3 pyramiding (= live default management exactly)
S3.rule: S3 mgmt == strategies.merge_mgmt('breakout_pyramid', {}): up to 2 adds of 0.5 x initial quantity at every +1R, 3 ATR chandelier trail, no time cap (the runtime has none)

S1-T.rule: plain stop plus a fixed 3R target, 42-bar cap

stages.choices: 42 bars = strategies ret42 = 7 days; 3R = house target; not tuned, no alternative is evaluated
stages.no_cap: S2 and S3 carry no time cap; finiteness comes from windows.last_entry_cutoff and the fail-closed boundary rule, never from a cap the runtime does not have
stages.r_unit: 1R = initial stop distance x initial quantity; adds and their costs are measured in that same initial R

episodes.entry_set: E = every S1 entry under the reentry rule (per symbol, re-arm only after the S1 episode closes). E is built once and is identical for S2, S3 and S1-T: stages differ only in what happens after the entry fill
episodes.unit_replay: an independent paired analysis, not a book: each episode in E is replayed at quantity 1 per stage. Because E re-arms on S1 exits, S2/S3 unit episodes on one symbol may overlap in time; overlap is allowed here and only here
episodes.paired_increment: D3(e) = netR_S3(e) - netR_S2(e) (adds only: S2 and S3 differ by nothing else); report-only: netR_S2(e) - netR_S1(e) (trail vs plain stop)
episodes.never_book: E and the unit episodes are never fed into the book

book.applies_to: the deepest credited stage only (DD, underwater, tails and sizing report)
book.source: built from the raw stage signals (le at bar close t, fill at the t+1 open), replayed with that stage's own exits; never from E
book.per_symbol: at most one open episode per symbol; a signal arriving while that symbol's episode is open is skipped and counted (skipped_open_symbol)
book.ordering: events are processed per 4h bar open in ascending timestamp; at one timestamp all exits first, then adds, then new entries; ties broken by symbol name ascending
book.admission: an entry is admitted only if open lots < 4 AND gross notional after the fill <= 3x equity; otherwise skipped and counted (skipped_max_open / skipped_gross_cap), never scaled down; an add that would breach the gross cap is skipped and counted (skipped_add_gross_cap)
book.account: 10000 USDT, 1.0% risk of equity per entry, historical stepSize/minQty/minNotional (floored, never rounded up; below minimum = counted refusal), every fill taker

H1.claim: the breakout entry has positive after-cost expectancy with a plain stop and no management
gates: expectancy (base mean net R > 0 and 95% LCB > 0)
all 3 chronological slices mean net R > 0
mean net R above the 95th percentile of the 1000 B0 random-entry books with the same exit

H2.claim: the trail stage (live management without adds) is itself positive after costs on the same entries
H2.test: S2 base mean net R > 0 with 95% LCB > 0, x1.5 mean net R > 0, mean net R > 0 in all 3 slices, plus the H1 remove-best-symbol and concentration gates

H3.claim: pyramid adds add after-cost value over S2 on the same entries
H3.test: paired D3 = S3 - S2: base mean > 0 with 95% LCB > 0, x1.5 mean > 0, positive in all 3 slices; AND S3 alone passes the H2 test
H3.credit: only if H1 and H2 passed

hypotheses.order: fixed sequence H1 -> H2 -> H3; a stage is never credited when an earlier one failed, whatever its own numbers; if H1 fails the family is FALSIFIED
hypotheses.report_only: S1-T and the S2 - S1 increment are diagnostics: never gated, never credited, never a rescue
hypotheses.credited_stage: S3 if H1, H2 and H3 pass; S2 if H1 and H2 pass; S1 if only H1 passes; none if H1 fails

costs.fee: Binance UM VIP0 taker 0.05% each fill, entries, adds and exits (costs.TAKER)
costs.slippage: slip-v1 on 4h closed bars with the slip-cal-v1 crypto coefficient; the 0.05% unfitted fallback each market fill while SLIP-C-UNFITTED
costs.funding: actual signed settled rate x funding-mark-proxy-v1 notional at each held event (entry <= T < exit); longs pay positive; the legacy flat per-bar funding is never used

stress_rows.base_x1: actual/base: fees x1, slippage x1, funding as settled
stress_rows.all_variable_costs_x1.5: fees x1.5, slippage x1.5, funding paid x1.5, funding received / 1.5
stress_rows.all_variable_costs_x2: report-only: fees x2, slippage x2, funding paid x2, funding received / 2

costs.stress_rule: base and x1.5 are both reported for every stage and both gate every gated stage; stress reprices the same episodes and is not a variant; received funding is never inflated

windows.slice_source: three contiguous chronological slices of the development window on existing EDGE04 / R4 / EDGE05 boundaries (about 2, 2 and 1.8 years); fixed before any result
windows.slice_rule: 4h bars; lookback 240 bars of warm-up; an episode belongs to the slice of its entry fill and is followed past an internal slice boundary to its exit (all of it is development data); the book runs once over the whole development window and its metrics are cut by entry slice

last_entry_cutoff.rule: no entry fill at or after sealed_cutoff - 180 x 4h; every stage and the book stop admitting entries there

windows.boundary_rule: an episode (unit or book) still open at the sealed cutoff is INCOMPLETE: fail-closed, excluded from every gate statistic, counted and reported per stage, and counted in the data gate; no price at or after the cutoff is read to close it

holdout.status: SEALED - not read, not opened, not scheduled by this contract
holdout.rule: nothing on or after the sealed cutoff is read
holdout.deferred_to_integration: whether a development survivor gets a new forward holdout or defers to the existing breadth_static40.v1 forward registration of breakout_pyramid.long (defaults mgmt, 2026-10-19 -> 2027-10-18) is for Integration; this contract neither opens nor alters it

windows.contamination: the parameters come from legacy research (research_long2 BRK1, research_combos BRK8, the #114 static-40 packet) and the universe from the factory triage; every pre-cutoff window is development evidence. A FAIL here is binding; a PASS is never acceptance or promotion evidence

baselines.rule: 1000 seeded random-entry books: per symbol and per slice the same number of entries as E, at uniformly drawn eligible 4h bar opens (same re-arm rule), with the S1 exit, R unit and costs
report-only: as B0 but drawn only from bars with EMA50 > EMA200 (the trend filter without the breakout)

trial_budget.book_replays: 1 (the credited stage only; not a trial)
trial_budget.multiplicity: three gated hypotheses in a fixed sequence H1 -> H2 -> H3, each at one-sided alpha 0.05; each is tested only if every earlier one rejected, so the family-wise error is <= 0.05 without adjustment. Diagnostics and B2 carry no test
trial_budget.prior_looks: at least 4 unledgered development looks at this family plus the Integration triage on this exact book; acknowledged by treating every result as development-only
trial_budget.rule: no result-dependent variant, no alternative channel / EMA / ATR / stop / horizon / trail / pyramid setting or symbol list; stress rows, report-only universes, folds, diagnostics and baselines never replace or rescue a failed stage

bootstrap.unit: mean net R per UTC ISO week of entry

metrics: per stage and per cost row (base, x1.5, x2): episodes, mean / median net R, PF, win rate, 95% LCB
per slice and per report-only fold
D3 (S3 - S2) mean, LCB, per slice; report-only S2 - S1
gross vs funding vs fee/slippage decomposition
boundary-INCOMPLETE episodes per stage and in the book
book skip counts: skipped_open_symbol, skipped_max_open, skipped_gross_cap, skipped_add_gross_cap, exchange-filter refusals
sizing report: the credited-stage book at fixed 1.0%, 0.5% and 0.25% risk per trade (DD, return, refusals)
episodes per 30 days and active symbols, per slice
credited-stage book: max equity DD, closed-R DD, longest underwater days, annualized after-cost return, return / max DD (Calmar), total net R / closed-R DD, exposure, trade count
per-symbol net R and share; remove-best-symbol result; top-1% episode share; worst episode and worst Cairo-day net R
notional / prior-24h quote volume, refusals by exchange filter

gates.data: every slice has at most 2% INCOMPLETE episodes (data gaps and boundary-INCOMPLETE together) and no unresolved accounting row; otherwise INCOMPLETE, not FAIL

activity.why: 300 / 75 keep the standard error near 0.09R overall and 0.17R per slice at a 1.5R episode spread, so a sign is readable per slice; 2 per 30 days rejects a book that trades too rarely to run; slice 1 predates SUI, ENA, WLD and 1000PEPE, so 8 of the 13 symbols then listed is the per-slice floor and 15 of 17 the whole-window floor

slices.rule: mean net R > 0 in every slice at base cost

stress.rule: base and x1.5 > 0 are PASS gates for every gated stage; x2 is reported

gates.remove_best_symbol: drop the symbol with the largest net-R contribution; mean net R of the remaining 16 > 0

drawdown_and_tail.tier_rule: PASS when the ordinary tier OR the profitability_rescue tier holds AND every all-path ceiling holds (monotone, as funding_carry_xsec.v1); base DD > 55% is FAIL on any path
drawdown_and_tail.high_risk_sleeve: a book that passes only via profitability_rescue is labelled HIGH-RISK SLEEVE and can only enter a separate explicit risk sleeve

gates.causality: no causality or accounting defect: fills obey the fills block, the runner's causal and accounting checks pass

kill.K1: S1 base mean net R <= 0 or 95% LCB <= 0 -> FALSIFIED
kill.K2: S1 x1.5 mean net R <= 0 -> FALSIFIED
kill.K3: S1 mean net R <= 0 in any of the 3 slices -> FALSIFIED
kill.K4: S1 remove-best-symbol mean net R <= 0, or concentration exceeded -> FALSIFIED
kill.K5: S1 not above the B0 95th percentile -> FALSIFIED (no entry edge over random entry)
kill.K6: H1 passes but H2 fails -> neither trail nor pyramiding is credited; only S1 remains, judged by the book gates
kill.K7: H2 passes but H3 fails -> pyramiding is not credited; S2 remains, judged by the book gates
kill.K8: the credited-stage book fails the DD tier rule, tails, underwater or causality -> FAIL
kill.K9: data or activity gate fails -> INCOMPLETE (never PASS, never silently FAIL)
kill.precedence: K1-K5 decide the family before any S2 or S3 number is read for credit

sizing.rule: the credited-stage book is reported at each fixed risk; no result-dependent risk budget is chosen here; the deployment risk budget is deferred to the later PAPER admission contract

verdict_rule: SURVIVES_DEV only names the deepest credited stage; it is development evidence, never acceptance, and never enables PAPER, shadow or live by itself

deferred.runner: no runner exists for this contract; a low-RAM streaming runner (EDGE05 runner pattern: run.json identity, hash-chained resumable lines, sealed-boundary refusal, --max-rss-mb) must reuse backtest.py path semantics and costs.py, and pass a synthetic parity test against backtest.py before any data read
deferred.evaluation_run: requires Integration authorization and RAM release by EDGE04
deferred.deployment_risk_budget: deferred to the later PAPER admission contract; sizing here is report-only
deferred.holdout: DEFERRED to Integration: this contract does not open or schedule any holdout
deferred.ledger: Integration writes the family ledger and REGISTRY line on signing
deferred.paper_live: no PAPER settings, testnet, shadow or live change
